items.title: Delfeayo Marsalis — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] That’s Robert Hurst, correct? [INTERVIEWEE] No, no, no.

ctx.x: challenge of recording acoustic jazz is always the volume of the bass juxtaposed to the volume of the drums. That’s it. If you can somehow figure that out, the rest is easy. What we realized early on was that the bass did not sound natural in Wynton’s early recordings.
